dimensions_note: tier: leading indicators headline a performance dimension; supporting concepts nest under a parent. insight: the actionable inference the concept exists to produce. chart: bars = granular growth-over-time view, spark = compact trend.

metrics.name: Backlog depth
metrics.intent: Admitted in-flight items (stages 1–3) on v_content. Unadmitted zombies at stage>=2 tracked separately in dims.
metrics.insight: Rising while discovery yields = dispatch starvation; falling with flat output = work being dropped not done. The single most revealing pipeline number.

metrics.name: Funnel snapshot
metrics.intent: Live v_content census: how many items sit at stages 0–4 right now, from the same view the reconciler uses. Stage 0 in corpus not admitted; 1 admitted waiting acquire; 2 audio staged waiting process; 3 processed waiting publish; 4 indexed. There is no stage 5.
metrics.insight: A pile at one stage names the stuck handler. Stage 0 growing while 1–4 are quiet = admission is off or discoverers are empty.

metrics.name: Recent-cohort conversion
metrics.intent: Of content admitted in the last 28d, share fully indexed (stage 4).
metrics.insight: Low with high discovery yield = pipeline is the bottleneck; consult failure_taxonomy for which category.

metrics.name: Failure taxonomy
metrics.intent: WHY units fail: error categories distilled from the nine recurring signatures.
metrics.insight: Dominant category names the PIT to spawn; a category flat across weeks = structural gap needing a master arc, not another patch.

metrics.name: Pipeline efficiency
metrics.intent: Compute-minutes per content unit completed - economies of scale at the pipeline.
metrics.insight: Falling over time = scaling; no_data with nonzero minutes = burning compute for zero output (worst case).

metrics.name: Cloud log noise
metrics.intent: WARNING+ log volume per Cloud Run job - degradation before it becomes failures.
metrics.insight: One job dominating names the target; rising noise with flat failure rate = silent retry waste.

metrics.name: Job failure rate (7d)
metrics.insight: Creeping rate = degradation between incidents; read with failure_taxonomy for the why.

metrics.name: Dispatch pulse
metrics.intent: Days since the funnel last moved work — indexed_at when stage-3 backlog exists, else admit/run activity.
metrics.insight: Anything above ~1.5 means the system is silently stopped regardless of platform status.

metrics.name: Diarization quality
metrics.intent: Named-speaker recall of the latest dispatch batch - attribution trust of the new flow.
metrics.insight: Falling while volume rises = scale bought with attribution debt; pairs with attribution_health (the stock).

metrics.name: Code restraint
metrics.intent: Churn without net growth from git history (insertions − deletions vs the commit 28d ago).
metrics.insight: Net near zero with healthy churn = replacement not accumulation; strong positive net with low ratio = the debt signature.

metrics.name: Code size
metrics.insight: Context for restraint; largest-file list names bloat candidates.

metrics.name: Patch churn
metrics.intent: Files appearing in >=3 git commits in 30 days (git log, not harness metadata).
metrics.insight: Hot files outside plates are where patching substitutes for design - prime master-arc targets.

metrics.name: Realised design smell
metrics.intent: Stock score of design-subversion habits + narration on the current pipeline tree (scorecard classifiers, no plates, not a git diff).
metrics.insight: Trend over absolute: rising smell with accreting code_restraint = the loop is patching instead of simplifying.

metrics.name: Ops sediment
metrics.intent: Loose one-off scripts in utils/ops/ root.
metrics.insight: Each new file is an incident that got a patch instead of a design; should trend down.

metrics.name: Factory plate growth
metrics.intent: Growth of the designated factory plates (conditions + subagent specs) - growth here is GOOD.
metrics.insight: Flat while incidents recur = learning not institutionalized; growth without incident metrics falling = rule theater.

metrics.name: Cloud components
metrics.insight: Phase 3 simplification must show here as a falling count.

metrics.name: HITL queue
metrics.insight: Aging queue = operator is the bottleneck or plans are not trustworthy enough to approve fast.

metrics.name: EP lead time
metrics.insight: The actuator half of signal response; long = implementation lane is the constraint.
